gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin reads as a plain sans whose tall lowercase nearly touches the capitals and whose curves stay held open, never curled shut. College hits harder, with every curve as stout as its stems.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-malayalam: College leads with stout, dynamic letters and no shift in weight anywhere. Anek Malayalam follows with minimal gap between lowercase and capitals, but make the heading small and that heft thins out fast.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-odia: College comes in with authority, its curves and stems carrying the same heft, while Anek Odia keeps its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook. Over a long passage, the sans stays easy and unhurried.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-tamil: College draws its letters as if with a round-tipped pen, dynamic and authoritative, with big counters in a tall lowercase. Anek Tamil answers with big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves, and that rounded generosity is what ties them.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu sets a reading rhythm of wide, tall bowls that stay unsealed. College adds stroke contrast of essentially zero above it, so the sans gives the page a steady, approachable footing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-anuphan: College has no hairlines to squint at, just stout dynamic letters with big counters in a tall lowercase, while Anuphan keeps big round bowls beneath. Both stay open and sturdy.
gen-dafont-college-gf-arimo: Arimo sets a tall mean line with roomy terminals. College is the one to make a statement, with every curve stout, while the sans simply carries the text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-armata: College is built on a monoline skeleton, dynamic and authoritative. Armata sets its lowercase bodies tall and leaves spacious gaps between characters, and that openness against the heavy heading is the pair's real strength.
gen-dafont-college-gf-athiti: Approachable Athiti keeps a gap you can see through in each s and a mean line set high. And College supplies the weight, dynamic and authoritative, every curve as thick as its stems.
gen-dafont-college-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Stout letters, then clipped capitals. College has a plain unmodulated outline, while Atkinson Hyperlegible sets wide terminals on its s, so a long passage in the sans stays approachable.
